identitySignals: Name matches: 'Language People, Inc.' (languagepeople.com), an interpreting and translation company
Its services (interpreting for IEP meetings, ASL and spoken-language interpreting) fit OUSD's Special Education contracts

Search listings place a Language People, Inc. office in Murrieta, CA (38750 Sky Canyon Dr), matching one agenda location; but the company's own site lists a PO Box in Hunters, WA, and nothing found mentions Menifee or OUSD, so the match is not confirmed
research.notes: Low confidence. The agenda gives Menifee and Murrieta, CA. The company website lists only a PO Box in Hunters, WA 99137, and the Murrieta address appears only in third-party search listings, which could not be fetched or confirmed. No CA Secretary of State or SAM.gov record was checked or found, and no page links this company to OUSD. Contact details were left out because of the location conflict. Could be a different 'Language People' (a local Riverside County business) with a similar name.

profile.summary: A company that provides spoken-language and American Sign Language interpreting and written translation services in over 150 languages, including interpreting for school meetings such as Individualized Education Program (IEP) meetings. It has operated since 1988 and was formerly called Bay Area Translations, Inc.
